title.en: Cut Off Trees for Golf Event

desc.zh: 从穿过高树的小路，推导按高度排序与分层最短路。
desc.en: Derive sorted targets and shortest paths from a walk past a taller tree.

complexity: O(Tmn + T log T) time; O(mn + T) auxiliary space

concepts.name: Ordered shortest paths
concepts.description: Static walkability makes the sum of shortest required legs optimal.

concepts.name: Breadth-first search layers
concepts.description: Discover each cell once at its shortest unit-cost distance.
